translations.translatedText: # Monday 30.9.2019 (radio)

Finland's population will start to shrink. People with a foreign background are well included in society. The shortage of workers is easing. Many people notice bullying at work. African swine fever is killing pigs in China.
## Finland's population will start to shrink
![A small baby girl sleeps contentedly in her mother's arms.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5694442)
Open image viewer
A baby in its mother's arms. Photo: Juha Korhonen / Yle

Finland's population will start to shrink in 12 years. Women are giving birth to fewer children than before. Statistics Finland calculates that in 15 years' time, births will not increase the population in any region. More people will die than are born, or about the same number, and the population will not grow.
Only in Uusimaa is the population growing, because people are moving to Uusimaa from other parts of Finland.
## People who speak other languages are well included in Finnish society
![Immigrants in a Finnish language lesson in Jyväskylä.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9085001)
Open image viewer
Immigrants in a Finnish language lesson in Jyväskylä. Photo: Matti Myller / Yle

Very many people with a foreign background have settled well into Finnish society. The study asked people who live in Finland, who speak different languages, about their experiences. More than 75% of respondents who speak Estonian, Russian, English, Somali and Arabic say that they are part of Finnish society.
Just as many do not feel that they are Finnish. Somali speakers most often feel that they are Finnish. Estonian speakers rarely feel that they are Finnish.
## The shortage of workers is easing
![An anonymous welder welds at an engineering works.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10966099)
Open image viewer
A welder welds at an engineering works. Photo: Antti Heikinmatti / Yle

The shortage of workers in construction has eased. There is no longer as severe a shortage of site managers, construction workers and welders as in earlier years. The growth in the labour shortage has stopped.
There is a big shortage of workers in social and health care jobs. Especially in the municipalities there is a shortage of doctors, social work specialists and kindergarten teachers.
## Many people notice bullying at work
![Workstation](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5413769)
Open image viewer
Bullying happens more in big companies than in small ones. Photo: Yle / Riikka Sipilä

Many employees see bullying at work. About 30% of white-collar workers say that bullying happens at their workplace. About 20% of white-collar workers say that they have experienced bullying themselves at work.
According to the study, bullying happens more in big companies than in small ones. Bullying happens a lot in the public sector, that is, in workplaces of the state and municipalities.
## African swine fever is killing pigs in China
![Butcher Li says that many customers now buy half as much meat.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10986153)
Open image viewer
The price of pork in China has risen, because there is a shortage of it. Photo: Jenny Matikainen / Yle
In China, an animal disease has killed a very large number of pigs. Perhaps half of China's pigs have died. The pigs have caught African swine fever and died. Many more pigs may die.
A lot of pork is eaten in China. There may be a shortage of meat in China, because many pigs are dying of African swine fever. Many pig farmers have lost their jobs, because the pigs have died.
